bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
dir="$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh api repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/tarball/c7ac87aa620a632987ab222350f2d43af46e7e2f > "$tmp/source.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$tmp/source.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" --strip-components=1
cd "$tmp"
for rid in req_202611271752000000002108 req_202611271852000000002109; do
 test -r "$dir/$rid.json"
 python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py "$rid" --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$dir"
done
